_doc: Where each resin's Buy link actually goes. The printer never sees this: profiles carry https://tinymakerwifi.com/r/<slug> (the firmware accepts a link only from our own domain), and the worker resolves it here. Value is the shop URL, or {"url": "...", "geo": {"US": "..."}} when the same resin is bought in different places depending on the buyer. Changing a partner is an edit here - no firmware release, no reinstalled profile. A slug missing from this file simply shows no link.
